tasks.statement:
MMT
Beyond Geography Olympiad 5

 Instructions

This test consists of 40 questions. Answer all questions and read
them carefully.
This tour is included in the total 3.5 hours allotted for the competition.
It is recommended that you spend no more than 1 hour on this tour.
Each question has 4 answer options. Only one answer is correct. If
you select two answers to a question, neither of them will be counted.
You can answer the questions in any order you like, but your answers
must be recorded in order from question 1 to question 40, otherwise
they will not be accepted.
Each question is worth 1 point.
This tour accounts for 30% of the competition.
Good luck!

    Puppet theatre on water is a Vietnamese tradition that served as entertainment
1   for peasants during floods and the rainy season. Nowadays, shows are held in
    shallow pools. However, originally, performances were held in places where
    the local population traditionally carried out their activities.
    Identify the activity associated with this art:

A             River trade

B             Aquaculture

C           Rice cultivation

D         Rainwater harvesting

2   Define the reason for the cold anomaly on the resource below:

    A              Atlantic Nina           C             Labrador current

    B               Hurricane              D               Azores high

3   At what stage of the Wilson cycle is the current Mediterranean Sea:

A       V

B        I

C       IV

D       III

4   What are the dark spots shown in the satellite image?

A              Upwelling

B                Oil spill

C             Nitrification

D          Phytoplankton bloom

5   Identify the process depicted in the diagram:

    A            Deindustrialisation        C       Rururbanization

    B               Renovation              D        Depopulation

6   In which country was this photo taken:

    A               Ukraine                  C   Belarus

    B               Lithuania                D   Serbia

7       Define the process responsible for forming this shape in blocks:

    A            Differential weathering       C            Selective weathering

    B             Biological weathering        D           Spheroidal weathering

    Identify the letter that corresponds to the correct arrangement of atmospheric
8
    fronts and pressure in the region.

9   Identify the incorrect statement using the profile below:

A      The depth of the abyssal plain exceeds 4 km.

B      There is a shelf present on the profile.

C      The deep-sea trench is located near North America.

D      The Mid-Ocean Ridge is located 4,500 km from North America.

     What factor causes the reddish-orange colour of the water in the Betsiboka
10
     River?

 A       Geothermal activity in the region

 B       Erosion of red lateritic soils

 C       Pollution from industrial wastewater

 D       Growth of freshwater algae

11   Here is a map of the territory from the game GTA: Vice City. Which real-life city
     was used as the basis for the city in the game?

A              Los Angeles

B                Miami

C                Orlando

D             Philadelphia

     You are given a supply and demand model, where supply is the amount of
     food produced at a certain price, and demand is the amount of food desired by
     buyers at the corresponding price. When the market is in equilibrium, the price
12
     is P1, but the government has set a minimum price of P2. Identify the correct
     consequence of this decision:

A      The market is still in equilibrium

B      There is a surplus on the market.

C      There is a shortage on the market.

D          Not enough information

13   Identify the landscapes where Andosols are most commonly found.

     A            Forest-steppe           C                 Tundra

     B               Deserts              D           Volcanic landscapes

14   Name the country marked with the letter ‘X’ on the graph:

     A               Ethiopia                C                    India

     B               Bangladesh              D                   Vietnam

15   The consequences of which process can be seen in the picture:

 A              Downburst

B                Tornado

C               Landslide

D                Mudflow

     In Scotland, there is an annual competition for skipping stones across water
     (‘pancakes’). According to the rules, the stones must be made of a specific
16
     type of rock found on the island.
     Identify the type of rock the stones must be made of.

 A                Basalt

B                  Slate

C                 Gneiss

D                Phylitte

     Study the diagram of the fracking process (extraction of natural gas using
     hydraulic fracturing).
17
     Identify the LEAST likely direct consequence of fracking for the environment.

A     Chemical contamination of groundwater

B    The risk of earthquakes and landslides

        Risk of large-scale soil erosion and
C
                    degradation

D    Toxic emissions into the atmosphere and
                   air pollution

18       What this cartogram illustrates:

              Inflation ratio for the periods taken              Gini index
     A                                                C

     B            Political Corruption Index          D   Political instability index

     What is the probable cause of high concentrations of PM-2.5 particles and
19   carbon monoxide (CO) in the selected area?

 A            Industrial pollution

 B         Dry season in the region

 C               Forest fires

 D           Uranium ore mining

20   Name the type of slum depicted in the photo:

 A                Favelas

B               Villa Miseria

C                 Dharavi

D                Banyoles

21   Identify what this map shows.

     A            Unemployment level           C          Gini index

     B      Life expectancy after retirement   D   Human Development Index

22   Determine whether the earthquake with a magnitude of 7.4 on 20 July is:

 A               Aftershock

 B              Mainshock

C             Not related event

D               Foreshock

23   Identify what is shown in the picture below:

A         The spread of “neglected tropical diseases”

B                The distribution area of lions

C           Regions of slash-and-burn agriculture

D       Regions of the ‘Old World’ affected by malaria

     Determine the climate type according to the Köppen classification that prevails
24
     in the winter habitat of saigas in Kazakhstan:

 A                 Dfb

 B                 BWh

 C                  Dfa

 D                  BWk

     The distance between the Sun and Earth is 150 million kilometres. A plasma
     cloud flew towards Earth at a speed of 500 kilometres per second. How long will
25   it take for the plasma cloud to reach Earth?
     Do not take friction or speed reduction into account.

 A                73 h

B                 92 h

C                 15 h

D                 83 h

     The picture illustrates chalk in Sussex, England. Identify what climate in
26   Sussex's past the chalk is evidence of:

 A           Warm, tropical shelf

B              Temperate plain

C                Polar shelf

D                  Tundra

     On 28 April 2025, the Iberian Peninsula experienced a near-total blackout.
27   Identify the least likely consequence:

A                   Urban fires

B          Mobile network disruptions

 C     Train service suspension in the Azores

D              Diplomatic scandal

     What innovations in agriculture resulted from the changes shown in the
28   video?

         Introduction of mechanisation in
A
                    harvesting

 B        Modern irrigation systems

          Plant breeding and genetic
C
                 modification

 D      Use of pesticides and fertilisers

29       Identify which country has the highest annual CO2 emissions:

     A               China                     C            Russia

     B               USA                       D            Curacao

30   What texture is illustrated on the rock in the image below:

A              Vesicular

B              Uniform

C               Aphanitic

D              Porphyritic

     Identify the biome from the movie below:
31

A            Temperate forest

B                Steppe

C           Tropical rainforest

D                Savannah

         What river is shown in the satellite image, given that it was taken by Landsat 8
32       and cities and vegetation are shown in orange?

     A                   Garonne                 C                  Seine

     B                  Moscow                   D                Dnieрer

33       Identify which natural disaster is shown below:

     A                 Earthquake             C            Tornado

     B               Landslide                D             Flood

         Orodruin, Pilhuerti Neika, Hill Valley, Mount Penlai, Sannikov Land: What do all
34
         these geographical features have in common?

                                                        All were formed by volcanic
     A               All refer to mountains        C
                                                                 processes.
             All were opened by the same person.
     B                                             D         They are all made up.

35       Identify the mountain range shown in the cross-section below:

     A                  Alps                  C              Cordillera

     B                Balkans                 D                 Andes

         On 15 November 2024, a session of the New Zealand Parliament was
36       interrupted by a ceremonial haka dance. Please indicate which people this
         dance belongs to:

     A                 Maori                  C               Evenki

     B                 Aleuts                 D                  Inuit

37       Which country is this export map typical of?

     A                  Peru                   C        Oman

     B               Kazakhstan                D        UAE

         The picture below shows an island from the series Game of Thrones -
38       Dragonstone. Identify the origin of the island:

     A                 Atoll                 C               Artificial

     B                Volcanic               D              Continental

39       Identify the climate type according to Köppen on this climatogram:

     A                  Cfb                   C                 BSh

     B                  Cwa                   D                 Dfc

40       Study the hurricane risk map below and identify the CORRECT statement:

                                                     C   Very high risk concentrated along the
     A           There is no risk for Hawaii.
                                                                   south-east coast
            The greatest risk on the west coast of       There is no risk of hurricanes in the
     B                                               D
                      the United States                             United States.

Congratulations on completing the tour!
Don't forget to send your answer sheet
     along with your written tour.
